tool.name: FAIRe-fier
tool.description: check FAIRe eDNA metadata against the FAIRe checklist
tool.command: set -o pipefail; ln -s '$input_file' input.xlsx && mkdir out && python '$__tool_directory__/fairefier_cli.py' input.xlsx --outdir out --checklist_dir '$__tool_directory__/checklist' --checklist_version '$checklist_version' $strict | tee '$log'

param.name: input_file
param.label: FAIRe metadata workbook
param.help: An Excel workbook with projectMetadata and sampleMetadata worksheets, for example a filled-in FAIRe-ator template. You can also give the fairefier_warn_error workbook from an earlier run after correcting its _revise worksheets.

param.name: checklist_version
param.label: FAIRe checklist version
param.option: Use the version recorded in checkls_ver (latest if not recorded)

param.name: strict
param.label: Stop with an error if validation fails
param.help: Useful in workflows, so later steps only run on valid metadata. The reports are still written.

tool.help:
**What it does**
This tool checks the projectMetadata and sampleMetadata worksheets of a FAIRe workbook against the `FAIR eDNA (FAIRe) <https://fair-edna.github.io/>`_ checklist. It checks that the mandatory fields are filled in, that values have the right type and format (numbers, dates, ENVO terms, durations), and that fields with a controlled vocabulary use allowed values. Where a value is close to an allowed one, it suggests the correct value.
These are the same checks as in the `FAIRe-fier web app <https://shiny.csiro.au/FAIRe-fier/>`_, taken from its public code on GitHub (`csiro/FAIRe-fier <https://github.com/csiro/FAIRe-fier>`_, version of 30 June 2026), and the tool writes the same output files. If the web app is updated after that version, the two may differ until this tool is updated too.
-----
**Inputs**
- **A FAIRe workbook** (.xlsx), with the field names in sampleMetadata on row 3, as in FAIRe templates. You can also give the *fairefier_warn_error* workbook from an earlier run, once you have corrected its *_revise* worksheets. - **The checklist version.** By default, the tool uses the version recorded in the *checkls_ver* field of projectMetadata, or the latest bundled version if none is recorded.
**Outputs**
- **summary** (JSON): whether each worksheet passed, the number of errors and warnings, and the checklist version used. - **warnings and errors** (tabular): one row for each problem, giving the worksheet, the sample or project column it is in (ALL if it applies to every one), the field, the value found, the message and any suggested value. - **workbooks** (collection):
- *fairefier_metadata*: the checked metadata, written when the worksheets pass. - *fairefier_warn_error*: the warnings and errors, plus *_revise* copies of your worksheets with the problem cells highlighted, red for errors and yellow for warnings.
- **log**: a record of the run.
-----
**Notes**
- An error in any one sample stops sampleMetadata from passing, and the same applies to projectMetadata. - The checklist defines *checkls_ver* as a number (for example 1), but FAIRe-ator templates fill it with the checklist file name, which FAIRe-fier reports as an error. Replace it with a number until the two tools agree. - Warnings about extra terms (fields not in the checklist) may appear in a different order from one run to the next.
@HELP_FAIRE_GUIDE@

The FAIRe checklist is described in Takahashi et al. (2025) *Environmental DNA* 7: e70100. The Galaxy tool was written by Oliver Berry (CSIRO), with Claude (Anthropic).
